en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a row of ornate late‑19th/early‑20th century apartment or town houses along a wide, mostly empty street. The buildings feature mansard roofs, decorative gables, bay windows, and wrought‑iron cresting on the roofline. The view is taken from across an open foreground area, and a few pedestrians can be seen on the sidewalk. At the top left, printed in red, is the caption naming the town and street.
